name: 13601 · Watertown, NY
findings: ZIP 13601 (Watertown) has 170 nonprofit organizations. 108 of them (64%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 91 organizations.
Health care organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 13601 (Watertown) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
